slides.title: 5 Italian words that don't mean what you think
slides.sub: Learn these before they embarrass you.

slides.meaning: Means “room”, not camera. Your hotel did not lose your Nikon.
slides.ex_it: La camera è al secondo piano.
slides.ex_en: The room is on the second floor.

slides.meaning: “Relatives”, not parents — those are genitori. Expect about 200 at Christmas.
slides.ex_it: A Natale vengono tutti i parenti.
slides.ex_en: At Christmas, all the relatives come.

slides.meaning: “Soft”, not morbid. A compliment for pillows and fresh bread.
A bookshop — or a bookcase. The library is the biblioteca.
slides.ex_it: Ho comprato il libro in libreria.
slides.ex_en: I bought the book at the bookshop.

slides.meaning: A condom. NOT a preservative. Never ask if the jam contains any.
slides.ex_en: “Does it contain preservatives?” — the safe version.

slides.text: Confess in the comments. Follow for more Italian survival tips.

5 Italian false friends 😅
